text:
raj: FYI customs flagged container #214 for incorrect hazardous labeling. Port hold until paperwork corrected. This container covers PR-4420 (Dedicated) and MKP-9001 (marketplace). Need reroute plan.

customs-bot: Alert: Hold placed 2024-11-02T03:12Z. Required action: shipper to supply amended MSDS and re-declare package class. Contact: broker@oceanline.example.

emily_ops: rough quantities? which reservations are impacted?

jun_supply: quick snapshot: PR-4420 = H100 x80, PR-4421 = RTX800 x24, MKP-9001 = H100 x40 reserved for marketplace, MKP-GREY = RTX800 x12. Local buffer region EU-north has H100 x16, US-east buffer has RTX800 x6.

raj: thanks. critical: PR-4420 has two enterprise customers with SLA "deployment window Nov 6-9". We can't miss that window without escalating.

nora_market: marketplace side: MKP-9001 has queued orders that are soft commitments, but we promised trial partners early access; prefer not to break trust.

kevin_sales: SI partner (Orion) has a joint announcement tied to PR-4420's onboarding on Nov 8. If capacity slips, they want to delay the announcement not to look flaky. Can we split shipments?

jun_supply: Deltatrace (shipper) says possible partial customs release if we repackage and relabel locally, but that needs proof of chain-of-custody and a customs agent onsite. Time estimate +72h. Alternative: divert to secondary port (adds +48h transit) but customs there can process faster.

raj: let's do a short impact matrix. priority order: 1) PR-4420 enterprise customers, 2) Orion SI announcement, 3) marketplace trials.

emily_ops: suggested mitigations:
- option A: local repack & relabel -> +72h, keeps original routing
- option B: reroute to Port B -> +48h transit, faster clearance but extra trucking
- option C: allocate buffers + temporary virtual capacity (quota shift) to cover spikes during wait

kevin_sales: if we use buffers, SI will expect the announced capacity. Can we commit?

jun_supply: available buffers: H100 EU-north x16, RTX800 US-east x6. Also can contact partner HarborAir for an emergency airlift of H100 x20 at significant cost.

nora_market: marketplace ops proposal: move MKP-9001 reservations to a "pending-hold" pool and surface ETA on partner portal as "delayed due to customs". We should auto-credit trial users if delivery slips >72h.

raj: decision call: go with Option B (reroute to Port B) for the main container to try to trim delay, and simultaneously allocate H100 x16 buffer to cover the highest-priority enterprise nodes until reroute completes. Approve airlift only if reroute fails.

jun_supply: action items:
- contact broker to start re-route paperwork (owner: jun_supply)
- reserve H100 x16 from EU buffer for PR-4420 (owner: raj)
- nora_market -> mark MKP-9001 as pending-hold and update partner portal copy (owner: nora_market)
- kevin_sales -> flag Orion for potential announcement delay and propose contingency comms (owner: kevin_sales)
- emily_ops -> prepare infra placement plan to use buffer capacity and changeover steps (owner: emily_ops)

kevin_sales: I'll draft a short note to Orion: explain customs hold, mitigation steps (reroute+buffer), ask for 72h flexibility on announcement.

emily_ops: infra note: will pre-provision 2 rack units per enterprise customer using H100 x8 each. need approval to shift autoscale quotas for those accounts.

jun_supply: re-route paperwork submitted to broker at 2024-11-02T04:05Z. ETA to Port B now estimated 2024-11-04T22:00Z.

customs-bot: Update: Port B has expedited inspection window pending. ETA clearance window 2024-11-05.

raj: allocated H100 x16 from EU buffer. tagging routes with "customs-temp" and lowering burst to prevent accidental consumption.

nora_market: marking MKP-9001 as pending-hold and pushing portal banner: "Some marketplace orders delayed due to shipping customs hold. More info via support." Draft credit policy: 15% usage credit if delivery >72h.

emily_ops: pre-provision done. changed quotas and deployed placeholders. monitor metric: queue-length and error-rate.

jun_supply: update from shipper: they can do partial local relabel but only for non-pressurized pallets (our RTX800s). Could release RTX800s earlier if we pay handling fee.

kevin_sales: Orion replied: prefer to keep announcement date but will mark it "availability subject to capacity" unless we can confirm full delivery by Nov 7. They accepted the contingency language for PR materials.

raj: ok. hold pattern: continue reroute, don't airlift yet. next status in 3h or earlier if changes. please add any blockers.

nora_market: FYI support template ready, will post copy to #customer-ops for review.

jun_supply: broker confirms Port B customs slot booked. trucking ETA to customer hubs updated.

emily_ops: monitoring shows no customer request spikes yet. metrics steady.

kevin_sales: SI wants a joint statement draft from marketing. I'll coordinate with @marketing and loop legal.

raj: thanks all. owners: jun_supply, nora_market, emily_ops, kevin_sales. keep updates here.

(END)
